text: はじめの　うちは　ポケモンを　よわらせてから　とるのが　コツじゃぞ！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　よわらせてから

patterns.name: 〜てから
patterns.explanation: てから means after doing that. よわらせてから = 'after weakening'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の turns an action into a thing. とるのが = 'catching them (is)'.

patterns.name: 〜うちは
patterns.explanation: うち means during a period. はじめの　うちは = 'while it's early on'.
